root_cause: The first owner experience connected its tabs to generic executive evidence and existing pages, but the UI never requested the independently validated tenant financial forecasts and canonical human decision state. A compact overview opened the same default tab for all five intents.
prevention_rule: Bind financial figures only through authenticated /api/portal-forecasts, server-resolved tenant, independently reviewed time series and separately labelled observed vs predicted periods. Route human approvals and rejections through existing canonical decision handler, with fail-closed stale status, readback and idempotency. Never infer provider execution or realized outcomes from approval.
